A free community where you learn Unreal: A free community where you learn Unreal Engine by playing an RPG. Every quest is a dungeon: read the guide, build it in the engine, beat the boss, open the chest. See {link}.
Join the {discord}, press Start Questing: Join the {discord}, press Start Questing there, then log in here with Discord.
No. Unrealcraft is free. Entitlements ar: No. Unrealcraft is free. Entitlements are earned, never bought.
Do I need to know Unreal Engine already?: Do I need to know Unreal Engine already?
No. Orientation and the Starter Quests b: No. Orientation and the Starter Quests begin at installing the engine and opening your first project.
Which engine version do I need?: Which engine version do I need?
Unreal Engine 5. Each quest links to the: Unreal Engine 5. Each quest links to the guide it was written against. State your engine version when you turn work in, so reviewers know what they are looking at.
A short quiz played as a turn-based figh: A short quiz played as a turn-based fight. Right answers land hits. Wrong answers wound you. You win with 80% or better.
Nothing is lost. Open the reading again: Nothing is lost. Open the reading again and retry whenever you are ready. There is no cooldown on a boss.
The turn-in. After the boss, you show yo: The turn-in. After the boss, you show your work with a few lines and a screenshot. Some quests are accepted at once, and others wait for a mentor.
Each rank opens a harder tier of dungeon: Each rank opens a harder tier of dungeons. Rank up to open the next tier.
Does my outfit or gear change the fight?: Does my outfit or gear change the fight?
No. Outfits, frames, colours and titles: No. Outfits, frames, colours and titles are looks only. Nothing but your answers decides a fight.
Ranks come only from quests. Each rank n: Ranks come only from quests. Each rank needs an XP total, the core path of your primary specialization, and a number of quests of that tier. Chatting earns no XP.
One of seven fields: Level Design, Progr: One of seven fields: Level Design, Programming, Environment Art, Tech Art, Gameplay Design, Animation and Cinematics. Each has its own quests and capstone dungeons.
Can I pick more than one?: Can I pick more than one?
Yes. Pick a primary, which sets your pat: Yes. Pick a primary, which sets your path, your rank requirements and your nameplate, and add as many others as you like on {link}. Quests in any of them count as yours.
Can I change my primary later?: Can I change my primary later?
Yes. Your finished quests stay finished. The quests your next rank needs will change to match the new primary.
Is there a reward for trying other speci: Is there a reward for trying other specializations?
Yes. Finishing quests across specializat: Yes. Finishing quests across specializations earns its own achievements and titles.
Everything you unlock: outfits, nameplat: Everything you unlock: outfits, nameplate colours, avatar frames, player card frames, titles and achievements. They come from ranks, milestones and staff grants.
A name shown after yours, like \"Kai, th: A name shown after yours, like "Kai, the Learner". Pick one you have earned in Edit profile, or pick None to hide it.
Who can see my player card?: Who can see my player card?
Logged-in members. You can also make it: Logged-in members. You can also make it Public so anyone with the link can open it. See {privacy}.
Can I change how the home banner looks?: Can I change how the home banner looks?
Yes. The small gear on the banner sets t: Yes. The small gear on the banner sets the season and time of day, and the button beside it pauses the motion. Your choice stays in your browser.
Who reviews my work, and where?: Who reviews my work, and where?
Mentors, admins and developers, here on: Mentors, admins and developers, here on the site. A review ends in Pass, Changes or Fail, with notes you can read on the quest page. Nothing is reviewed on Discord.
What is the Discord server for, then?: What is the Discord server for, then?
It is the guild hall: a place to talk, a: It is the guild hall: a place to talk, ask questions and show off your progress. Your roles there follow your rank and specialization here. Join at the {discord}.
How long does a review take?: How long does a review take?
Reviewers are volunteers, so it varies. You can keep questing while you wait.
A quest is wrong or a link is dead. What: A quest is wrong or a link is dead. What do I do?
Tell staff on the {discord}. Quests are: Tell staff on the {discord}. Quests are fixed in the curriculum and the fix shows in the {changelog}.
How do I delete my account?: How do I delete my account?
Message staff on Discord. The {privacy}: Message staff on Discord. The {privacy} lists what is removed.
Is Unrealcraft part of Epic Games?: Is Unrealcraft part of Epic Games?
No. It is a community project and is not: No. It is a community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games.
